summary: Price breaks and stock from the element14 Product Search API, which serves the Farnell, Newark and element14 stores (read-only).
privacy: The keyword the price check searches for (from your parts list) and the store go to Farnell (element14, Newark) with your key. Farnell's terms don't allow storing its data, so Morph keeps the answers only in the run, deleted after 7 days.

verified.notes: Query parameters and the keywordSearchReturn answer come from the Product Search API (REST) description page, read on 2026-10-13; the tests' answer is its medium response group example. Only keyword searches (term any:) are used.

credentials.label: element14 Product Search API key
credentials.what: Lets the price check look up Farnell, Newark and element14 price breaks and stock for the parts in your parts list.
credentials.where: element14 Partner Portal: register, then request a Product Search API key
credentials.cost: Morph adds no fee; Farnell sets a query limit for each key (Partner Portal terms).

tools.name: element14_search_keyword
tools.title: Farnell keyword search
tools.description: Search the Farnell, Newark and element14 catalog, one store at a time, with a keyword or a manufacturer part number. Returns up to 5 products with the store's order code (sku), name, brand, manufacturer part number, minimum order quantity, price breaks (from, to, cost) and stock by warehouse. Prices are in the store's own currency, which the answer does not name. Farnell serves Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Japan, Newark the Americas (www.newark.com) and element14 Asia Pacific: pick the store for the person's region.
tools.sends: the keyword (a part number or a short description) and the store

term.description: any: followed by a keyword or manufacturer part number, for example any:STS3215

store.description: The store to search, for example www.newark.com or uk.farnell.com

cost.note: Farnell sets a query limit for each key.
